description: This file contains Redux action creators and async logic for managing roles in the Mattermost application, including fetching roles by name or ID, editing roles, and loading roles conditionally.

methods.name: getRolesByNames
methods.description: Fetches multiple roles by their names using the client function.

methods.name: getRoleByName
methods.description: Fetches a single role by its name.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Fetches a role by its ID.

methods.name: editRole
methods.description: Edits a role with the provided partial role data.

methods.name: setPendingRoles
methods.description: Sets the list of pending roles in the Redux store.

methods.name: loadRolesIfNeeded
methods.description: Conditionally loads roles if they are not already loaded, batching requests by name.
